name: @standard-change/oneui
description: Shared UI surface. NOT an app: no routes.json, no port, nothing to deploy on its own. Every app depends on it, which is exactly why it lives outside apps/. `version` is a COPY of oneui.js's exported VERSION, which is the source; shared/tests/oneui.test.mjs fails if they drift. Nothing imports this file -- the apps import ../../../shared/oneui.js by path -- so this number constrains no dependency and pins no release.
